status: Recorded before execution or inspection of new held-out scores
purpose: Compare four explicit source-related BCI response models and a limited correction for task-specific response centers
full_data_starts: 16 predetermined Sobol starts plus the fitter's generic canonical start, the matching published source start, and zero-center embedding of the fitted unshifted model for shifted models
cv_starts: 8 predetermined Sobol starts plus the generic canonical start only; selected for a fixed runtime budget before any held-out score is inspected
cv_forbidden_initialization: No published full-data parameters, full-data fitted parameters, or full-data labels enter initialization or fitting of any training fold
cv_split: Each participant/task/condition/asynchrony cell's ten binary outcomes are independently permuted once and partitioned into five pairs. Each fold trains on eight and scores the remaining two.
cv_interpretation: Artificial conditional-exchangeability partitions of aggregate binary counts; no real trial chronology, no independent replication, and no population generalization are reconstructed
numerical_quality_rule: Use the supplied fixed refinement for failed status or projected gradient greater than 1e-3. Record unresolved failures, projected gradients, bounds, and every starting objective. Do not select models or retries by scientific significance or held-out score.
reported_outputs: All full-data and training-fold fits, parameters, predictions, source starts and nesting provenance, held-out count scores, fold memberships, convergence diagnostics, absolute count deviance, and paired participant score contrasts
new_model_scope: Exactly two task centers fixed across all three stimulation conditions. No additional centers or flexible curve features are added.
